[[File:Lentils patch.gif|left|thumb|Lentils growing in the garden.]]
Lentils are a form of crop which can be grown from [[Lentil seed]]s in the garden below the [[workyard]] known as the [[Kitchen Garden]].  To grow they require the [[Garden bed with sticks]].  Alternatively they can be purchased from the [[Farmer]]. Lentils are an improvable crop, meaning they have a variety of quality levels and can be improved with fertilizer.  See the page on [[farming]] for more information on how crops are grown and improved.

==Alchemy==
Lentils can be decomposed to fluid at either of the two distillation cubes. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] will produce one additional ingredient at any distiller.
